Present : Mr. Vinod Ghai, Senior Advocate with
 Mr. Gaurav Dutta, Advocate and
 Ms. Kashish Sahni, Advocate
 for the petitioner.
 Mr. Deepinder Singh Brar, Senior Dag, Punjab.
 *

The petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 482 read with Section 528 of Bharatiya
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with a prayer to grant anticipatory bail to her in case Fir No.448
dated 15.11.2023, registered under Sections 420, 406, 120-B of Ipc and Section 24 of Immigration
Act, at Police Station Sohana, District Sas Nagar, Mohali.

2.  In compliance of order dated 28.03.2025 passed by this Court, status report by way of an affidavit of Superintendent of Police (City), District SAS Nagar, Mohali has been filed by learned State counsel in Court today and the same is taken on record.

Learned State counsel submits that during the investigation conducted so far, the involvement of the petitioner has not been found and her custody is not required by the Investigating Agency in the present case.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:049635 3. In view of the statement made by learned State counsel, the present petition has been rendered infructuous.
